issue.title: Apply the committed plugins.sync allowlist on apollo and restore local plugin deployment
issue.description: Proposing bead: bob-cli-lh.3, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 2. On apollo 2026-11-14, bob plugins sync --dry-run from bob-plugins 6a1778b exits 2: ~/.config/bob/config.yml has no plugins.sync list. The source-of-truth chezmoi home/dot_config/bob/config.yml already has the complete explicit plugin list, including bob-ledger-tools, in c4e38c8a (2026-11-13). Root cause is unapplied host configuration, not missing code or an absent source list. The managed Bob config diff also contains unrelated changes (111 lines at observation), so review it and preserve intentional host edits before converging it. Open chezmoi through sase repo; use its managed apply workflow, never replace the whole home tree blindly. Then run bob plugins sync from the intended opened bob-plugins checkout and verify normal deployment, following protected-deploy rules without -F. No new plugin selection or allowlist implementation is needed. Distinct from bob-cli-lg, which is a Mac rollout blocked by SSH, and from protected-dirty-deploy bugs. All-status searches, recent-task sweep, and active-epic causal review found no duplicate.

task_type_fields.proposal: Converge the already-committed plugins.sync list onto apollo, then verify local bob plugins sync can deploy normally.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The allowlist requirement and chezmoi source change predate bob-cli-lh; local config rollout blocks all plugin work and does not require Bank Badge implementation changes.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-lh.3 note 2 reported a blocked deployment. Landing reproduced the missing local allowlist although chezmoi c4e38c8a already supplies it; this host rollout is separate from the badge code.
